title: Extremal Graphs: Ramsey R(s, t) & C4-Free Turán ex(n, C4) Witness Frontiers
description: Pure Lean 4.36.0 (zero Mathlib) certified optimization across 16 classical extremal graph witness frontiers: 8 two-color Ramsey lower bounds R(s, t) (maximizing vertex count N with no K_s and no I_t) and 8 C4-free Turán graphs ex(n, C_4) for n = 25..40 (maximizing edge count e with no 4-cycle). `ExtremalGraphs/Spec.lean` formally proves soundness of both the active-filtered Tomita greedy-coloring clique-freeness prover and the bitwise C4-freeness checker (`m &&& (m - 1) == 0`). Pinned to `chrispbsmolen/ramsey-witnesses@d21fda5` (MIT).

tasks.title: Maximize R(3, 8) witness graph order N (baseline 21)
tasks.description: Submit a symmetric, loopless adjacency-bitmask graph on N vertices in `ExtremalGraphs/Ramsey3_8.lean` (`ExtremalGraphs.score_ramsey_3_8` and `ExtremalGraphs.rows_ramsey_3_8`) avoiding both K_3 and independent sets of size 8, certifying R(3, 8) ≥ N + 1. Seeded with a constructive 21-vertex algebraic graph (frontier: 27 (R(3,8)=28 exact)). Frozen `ExtremalGraphs/BoundRamsey3_8.lean` kernel-verifies graph symmetry, irreflexivity, and absence of K_3 and I_8 via active-filtered Tomita greedy-coloring branch-and-bound (`decide +kernel`).

tasks.title: Maximize C4-free graph edges on n = 25 vertices (baseline 52)
